summary: Sibling of Carmela 'Mollie' Gianetta; John's great-grand-uncle/aunt.
bio:
Listed among Mollie's siblings in the FS tree (Savino 1897-1964, Mariano Martin 1899-1941, Maria 1902, Antonio 1907-1998, Giuseppe 1912-1971, Rosa 1914, Charles J. 1916-1975). The family lived in Dunmore (Ward 5) 1910-30.

Mariano (Martin) died in Scranton on 24 February 1941, aged about 41. The state death index records him twice, as 'Mariano Giannett' and as 'Martin Genette', under the same file number 18787 ([R4-S1]). In the 1910 census he appears as 'Marianna', son, 11, and in 1920 as 'Marion', 20, a coal-breaker laborer ([R4-S2], [R4-S3]). His widow was Mary (Santoli). Their daughter Angela Genett, 20, of 138 Sand Street, married Anthony Joseph DePietro at Dunmore on 16 Oct 1943, with her mother's consent because her father was dead ([R4-S4]).
